missing_evidence: Postgres connection pool wait/active metrics for order service over the incident window
Order service logs showing pool acquisition timeouts
candidates.statement: Order service postgres.save_order fails with DependencyUnavailable while the connection pool reports size=5 and idle=0 across all sampled traces, so checkout requests time out and the gateway returns 502.
candidates.uncertainty: No postgres pool saturation metrics or logs admitted; pool size/idle come only from trace attributes.

report.explanation: Traces show every checkout failing at postgres.save_order with DependencyUnavailable and pool idle=0, propagating 503 from order and 502 at gateway; metrics confirm 16 502s on /v1/checkout with p95 ~2425ms. Redis and payment calls succeed, so pool exhaustion at order is the bounded candidate; logs were excluded.
